content: We use three baseline approaches for the task of predicting whether a query is out-of-scope: (1) oos-train, where we train an additional (i.e. 151st) intent on out-of-scope training data; (2) oos-threshold, where we use a threshold on the classifier's probability estimate; and (3) oos-binary, a two-stage process where we first classify a query as in- or out-of-scope, then classify it into one of the 150 intents if classified as in-scope.
